text: DSH Custom Web Search（DSH Web 插件）：为 DSH Web 的网页搜索接入可配置的多引擎搜索链。它注册 cust-search 搜索提供方，并按设置顺序调用 DeepSeek、Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG、Tavily、AnySearch、Exa、Keenable、Firecrawl、Parallel 和 Perplexity；单个引擎失败或超时会继续尝试后续引擎。Web 设置页可调整引擎顺序和超时、管理凭据，并用测试搜索检查单个引擎。适合需要切换搜索来源或设置备用搜索服务的 DSH Web 用户；部分引擎可选配置对应 API 密钥。

DSH Custom Web Search adds web search to DSH Web. It tries enabled engines in order, moving on after failure or timeout. Settings reorder engines, set timeouts, manage credentials, and test searches. Sources include DeepSeek, Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG, and API/MCP providers; some use API keys.
想让 DSH 网页搜索可以换不同的搜索引擎。
搜索服务偶尔不可用时，能不能自动换备用来源？
我想调整网页搜索引擎的优先顺序和超时时间。
I want DSH web search to use several selectable search engines.
Can searches fall back to another provider when one times out?
I need a settings page to reorder engines and test a search source.
DSH Custom Web Search 的功能「顺序回退」：按保存的引擎顺序执行网页搜索；某个引擎失败或没有可用结果时继续尝试后续引擎，成功后返回结果。
DSH Custom Web Search 的功能「引擎配置与测试」：在插件设置页调整启用引擎的顺序和请求超时、配置凭据，并输入查询测试单个引擎及其返回结果。
DSH Custom Web Search 的功能「多来源搜索接入」：注册 DSH Web 搜索提供方，提供 DeepSeek、Bing、DuckDuckGo、SearXNG 及多个 API/MCP 搜索适配器供搜索链调用。

Custom Web Search plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) WebUI. Searches through configured engines in order, automatically trying the next engine if one fails or times out.

---

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Core Features：- **Sequential Search**: Searches engines one by one in your configured order. If an engine encounters a network error, invalid key, or timeout, it automatically moves to the next enabled engine until it gets results.
- **11 Search Engines Supported**: Built-in support for official DeepSeek bridge, free search engines (Bing, DuckDuckGo, SearXNG), and AI search engines (Tavily, Exa, Firecrawl, Parallel, Perplexity, etc.).
- **Model-facing excerpts preserved**: DSH 0.2.2 split a source's text into a display `snippet` and a longer `summary` for the model. The plugin forwards both, so the official DeepSeek Search API's summaries reach `web_search` at their full length instead of being flattened to a 300-character snippet.
- **Readiness-aware tool visibility**: the provider implements the optional `ready()` hook, so a chain whose every enabled engine is missing its credential hides `web_search` rather than failing after the model calls it.

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Supported Search Engines：| Engine | ID | Type | Credential | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **DeepSeek Official** | `deepseek` | `Bridge` | Official plugin settings | Bridge to the official providers: `deepseek-search-api` (direct Search API) preferred, `deepseek-official` (Messages `web_search`) as fallback |
| **Bing** | `bing` | `Free` | None | Region/locale-driven web search |
| **DuckDuckGo** | `ddg` | `Free` | None | HTML primary channel with Lite fallback |
| **SearXNG** | `searxng` | `Free` | None | Rotates public instances or custom endpoints |
| **Tavily** | `tavily` | `Keyed` | `TAVILY_API_KEY` | High-quality API when keyed, shared channel when keyless |
| **AnySearch** | `anysearch` | `Free` | None | Keyless structured AI search |
| **Exa** | `exa` | `Keyed` | `EXA_API_KEY` | Neural search; REST when keyed, public MCP when keyless |
| **Keenable** | `keenable` | `Keyed` | `KEENABLE_API_KEY` | Real-time search; REST when keyed, free MCP when keyless |
| **Firecrawl** | `firecrawl` | `Keyed` | `FIRECRAWL_API_KEY` | Deep scraping; anonymous quota when keyless |
| **Parallel** | `parallel` | `Keyed` | `PARALLEL_API_KEY`

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Supported Search Engines：> The `deepseek` bridge reuses the official DeepSeek providers. DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 ships two: `deepseek-search-api` (one direct Search API request, no model turn, takes a result count) and `deepseek-official` (a Messages turn with the native `web_search` server tool). The bridge prefers the direct API and falls back to Messages search, skipping a registered provider only while another one reports itself usable — with neither configured it still picks one, so the missing-key error names the key instead of claiming nothing is registered. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web` exposes no public "provider by id" accessor, so the bridge reads the web runtime's provider registry directly (one adapter, `src/server/engines/deepseek.ts`) and degrades to "engine unavailable" if that internal shape changes.

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Quick Install (Recommended / One-Line)：Install directly from the GitHub `dist` branch (pre-built by CI, no local compilation needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:u9521/dsh-cust-search#dist
```

Then **restart web** (`dsh web`) and **hard-refresh** your browser (Cmd+Shift+R or Ctrl+F5). The configuration page lives on the plugin's own card: **Plugins → Installed → `@local/dsh-cust-search`**.

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Upgrade：Pull the latest release using the `dsh plugin update` command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web update @local/dsh-cust-search
```

Then **restart web** and **hard-refresh** the browser.

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Storage & Configuration：Configuration is stored in an isolated user directory without modifying system settings:

- **Storage Path**: `~/.dsh/storages/cust_search.json` (a `ctx.storage.domain` unit: `{ "unit": {...}, "global": {...}, "tables": {} }`)
- **Schema Details**: For complete schema specifications and field definitions, see [Storage Schema Specification](docs/schema.md).

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Prerequisites：- **pnpm**: `npm install -g pnpm`
- **Node.js**: `^22.19 || >=24`

@local/dsh-cust-search README · 1. Clone & Build：```sh
git clone https://github.com/u9521/dsh-cust-search.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-cust-search
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-cust-search
pnpm install
pnpm run build

@local/dsh-cust-search README · 2. Local Install：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-cust-search
```

Then **restart web** (`dsh web`) and **hard-refresh** the browser.

@local/dsh-cust-search README · 3. Local Upgrade：Upgrading local sources only requires pulling the latest commit and rebuilding:

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-cust-search
git pull
pnpm run build
```

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Development Commands：| Command | Description |
| :--- | :--- |
| `pnpm run build` | Full build (`tsc` type check, then `lib/` bundles; fails if the host artifact inlined a package the host already provides) |
| `pnpm run check` | Type check only (`tsc --noEmit`) |
| `pnpm run lint` | Full lint check (ESLint + TypeScript + Prettier) |
| `pnpm run lint:fix` | Automatically fix ESLint rules and format code |
| `pnpm run fmt` | Format source and config files with Prettier |

@local/dsh-cust-search README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove @local/dsh-cust-search
```

Restart web and hard-refresh the browser afterwards. If local sources are no longer needed:

```sh
rm -rf ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-cust-search
```
